title: 470kW Solar Energy Storage Reference Project in Germany
summary: A 470kW solar-plus-storage reference project in Germany.
challenge: European solar-storage projects carry grid-compliance documentation and long-term reliability requirements that shape the architecture before the equipment is chosen.
solution: A commercial cabinet or containerised ESS architecture matched to the 470kW array, with PCS pairing and grid rules confirmed at design stage.
